name: Bronx Rockets
description: The Bronx Rockets were a teenage gang active in the late 1940s and early 1950s in the Bronx, operating around 156th Street near Jackson Avenue in the Melrose neighborhood. On May 25, 1949, members of the Rockets attacked and killed Theodore Segarra, the president of the rival Lightnings gang, following a period of feuding between the two groups.
